projects.title: Major cases occurs at the Rohingya Refugee camps

content.alt: UNOCHA project monitoring

content.text: The funded project's objective is to manage the major cases occurs at the Rohingya Refugee camps. The migrant children regularly face severe misconduct such as neglect, harm, abuse, exploitation, harrassment,etc, which are identified, monitored and solved by the appointed case workers. My responsibility under UNOCHA project as an MIS is to deploy the case management database, analysis collected data and report the cases, case progress and major case trends. However, already completed the first phase of this project and got assigned for the second phase till december 2027. My aim for the second phase is to report major case trends and highlight the extremely risky camps on maps. Moreover, the facility offices will be demonstrated on GIS based maps on upcoming day.

projects.title: Knowledge Level of Women in Bangladesh about PCOS
projects.summary: Research on how much women in Bangladesh know about polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and on depression, anxiety, stress and total distress scores by PCOS status.

content.text: This research assesses the knowledge level of women in Bangladesh about PCOS and compares mean depression, anxiety, stress and total distress scores across PCOS status (Not Known, Positive, Negative). Knowledge was low for most women (63.7%), moderate for 21.5% and high for 14.7%. Mean scores for all four measures were highest among women with a positive PCOS status.

projects.title: Health Hazards Among E-waste Recyclers in Chattogram City
projects.summary: Cross-sectional survey of 84 e-waste workers in Chattogram City Corporation on workplace injuries and health issues by working category (collecting, burning, dismantling).

content.text: A purposive cross-sectional survey of 84 e-waste recyclers in Chattogram City Corporation, collected through face-to-face interviews using Kobo Toolbox and analyzed in SPSS. Workers involved in burning and dismantling showed significant associations with cuts and burns, itching and skin problems, and red, itchy eyes (p = 0.00).

content.alt: Cross-tabulation of work involvement (collecting, burning, dismantling) and health issues among e-waste recyclers.

projects.summary: Participation in a two-day training on MHPSS, including Psychological First Aid (PFA), organized by Save the Children under the Child Protection program, Cox's Bazar.

content.text: Took part in the two-day training on Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS), including Psychological First Aid (PFA), organized by Save the Children's Child Protection program in Cox's Bazar. The sessions combined presentations with scenario-based group work, such as responding to the reactions of children and adults after a school fire, and group exercises, including mapping activities.
